drhp.business: The Indian Wood Products Co. Ltd. manufactures Katha, extracted from the heartwood of the Khair (Acacia Catechu) tree, along with Cutch as a by-product used in vegetable tanning and industrial applications. Katha is sold mainly as a paan ingredient with additional demand from pharmaceutical and wellness (Ayurvedic) applications, with the Company's products holding a market presence across India.

demand_drivers.body:
- Demand for Katha is supported by its dual utility as a paan-industry ingredient (concentrated in Assam, West Bengal, Bihar, Odisha, with additional popularity in Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Maharashtra) and as a constituent in traditional Ayurvedic formulations, giving a diversified demand base.
- Growing consumer preference for natural and herbal products is expected to further support demand for Katha in pharmaceutical and wellness applications.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- FY2025-26 Katha sales volume declined (3,846.70 MT vs 3,983.24 MT in FY2024-25) primarily due to limited availability of quality raw materials, which impacted production levels.
- The Company is exposed to price fluctuation risk on both raw materials and finished goods; it manages this through forward booking, inventory management and vendor development practices.
